description:
Use this when you need a deterministic Kenya Kenya 2026 nationwide public-holiday layer over a Saturday-Sunday working-week baseline result. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when this package covers the nationwide public-holiday layer only. It is not a universal private-employer, bank, school, county, sector, diplomatic or shift-work calendar. The Saturday-Sunday baseline is a calculation convention for ordinary weekday work, not a claim that every employer uses the same roster. Idd-ul-Fitr and Idd-ul-Adha are pinned to the 2026 Gazette declarations; future lunar dates and later special notices require a refreshed package. The Act's Sunday substitution rule is preserved and no Saturday-to-Monday substitution is inferred.
What it computes: Checks a date against the Saturday-Sunday weekend baseline and exact 2026-2026 authority events.
Example user requests: Kenya: Idd-ul-Fitr public holiday. | Kenya: Ordinary Kenya working day.
Inputs: date (date).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"date":"2026-03-20"} | {"date":"2026-09-14"}
Outputs: territory, territory_name, weekday, is_working_day, day_type, holiday_names, holiday_kinds, holiday_details, calendar_scope, holiday_policy, substitute_day_policy, calendar_profile, dataset_version, sources.
Formula: is_working_day = not an official Saturday/Sunday weekend date and no exact authority event
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/kenya-public-working-day with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/kenya-public-working-day.md

date.description: Gregorian date in Kenya's pinned 2026 nationwide public-holiday coverage over a Saturday-Sunday baseline.

name: check_ke_working_day

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

calendar_scope.description: Kenya 2026 nationwide public-holiday layer over a Saturday-Sunday working-week baseline

day_type.description: Deterministic classification: official_weekend, regular_workday, or the first published authority event kind.

holiday_details.description: Structured event details, including partial-day notes where published.

is_working_day.description: Monday-Friday with no event in this pinned authority scope.

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: Kenya Working Day
